lead.headline: Tuten is questionable, and his only cover locks at noon
lead.deck: Still limited Wednesday. Friday's report decides: doubtful or out means Rice before 12:00.
lead.body: Bad news first: Bhayshul Tuten was limited Wednesday with his ankle and foot and is still questionable. Woody Marks is out tonight with the concussion, Josh Jacobs is out and on bye, and Rice and Odunze kick off at 12:00 — so nobody can replace Tuten at Jacksonville's 13:55 inactives. The rule stands: if Friday lists him doubtful or out, move Gordon to RB and start Rice before noon; otherwise start Tuten. Jonathan Taylor opens your week tonight at Houston with no designation, but in a 29-18 carry split with Seth McGowan and with Indianapolis 12.5-point underdogs. Geno Smith, Wilson's quarterback, was limited; Rice practised in full.
